target_user: A single home user keeping track of their own book collection and informal loans to family
core_utility: A simple personal tracker for the books on your shelves at home — what they are, who you've lent them to, and which are currently out.
assumptions: Single local user on their own computer, no login or sharing
Status derives live from whether a borrower name is filled in
Category suggestions include common book types with free-text override
Browser-local storage only; no cloud sync
